12 meals provide food for 18 people, so each meal feeds 18/12 = 1.5 people. To feed 12 people, they need 12 / 1.5 = 8 meals.

Solution A wrongly assumes each meal is 1.5 portions and then divides 18 by 1.5, which answers a different question (how many meals make up the 18 portions), and it also gets the arithmetic wrong in framing. Solution B reaches 8, which matches.

WINNER: B
